title: World Sequence
description: One reference biome expands into traversal, storm, and night-state views while preserving the same landmark system.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the biome landmark stack, traversal routes, and palette; images 02-04 use it as a strict reference while shifting route emphasis and atmosphere across the same playable region.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01 first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-04. Queue may run 02-04 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
